question: What was the theme of the 28th National Conference on e-Governance scheduled for 22 and 23 September 2025 in Visakhapatnam?

options.text: Viksit Bharat: Civil Service and Digital Transformation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Viksit Bharat: Civil Service and Digital Transformation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **28th National Conference on e-Governance (NCeG)** is scheduled to be held on **22 and 23 September 2025** in **Visakhapatnam**, **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• The primary theme for this edition of the conference is **"Viksit Bharat: Civil Service and Digital Transformation"**, reflecting the nation's focus on modernization and the role of the bureaucracy in achieving a developed India status.
 
• The event is organized by the **Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG)** in collaboration with the **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)** and the **Government of Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• The conference serves as a major platform for **policymakers**, **practitioners**, and **industry experts** to discuss the latest trends in **digital governance** and the integration of technology into public service delivery.
